findings.title: A third catch-all-401 site was left open: resolveOwnerScope relabels any non-AuthError requireRole rejection as ScopeError('unauthorized', 401)
findings.arbiter_reasoning: FIXED at 322aeaa5d. `src/lib/auth/resolve-owner-scope.ts:113` is now `throw err;`. Verified four ways. (1) Mutation: reverting to `throw new ScopeError('unauthorized', 401)` kills both re-throw tests, and forcing the AuthError guard true kills them too — the new behaviour is genuinely asserted, not asserted-by-absence. (2) The raw re-throw is safe for every consumer: all FIVE call sites across the four consuming files end their catch with a bare re-throw after an `instanceof ScopeError` guard — settings/postal-address/route.ts:93, dashboard/import-offer/route.ts:135, past-replies/draft-status/route.ts:65, past-replies/_shared/edit-reply-request.ts:82 and :189. None swallows, none returns 200, none reads `.statusCode` off an unguarded error. (3) The preamble could ALREADY throw a raw non-ScopeError before this change (lines 143 and 148 re-throw `Promise.allSettled` rejection reasons), so no consumer contract is newly widened. (4) No assertion class was lost with the deleted 401 test: `ScopeError` identity plus message plus statusCode are still asserted by the AuthError test (line 124) and the no_business tests (lines 159, 248), and mutant M4 proves the AuthError arm is live. `rejects.toBe(boom)` is strictly stronger than the deleted `toMatchObject` for the re-throw path.
